name: Comment Reply Clinic
why_it_works: A question from a real-looking viewer is social proof that other people wonder the same thing, so the viewer feels safe being curious. A face answering directly feels like a free consultation, and asking for the next question turns the comments into a lead list.

hook.pattern: Open on a viewer's question shown as a comment card, so the first thing seen is a problem someone actually has.
examples: This comment deserves a real answer.

variables.name: presenter_name
variables.description: The client's own presenter (their face and voice only)

variables.name: viewer_question
variables.description: A real or permitted viewer question, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: Do I need a will without a house?

variables.name: short_answer
variables.description: The direct answer, 6 words or fewer
variables.example: Yes, if anyone depends on you

variables.name: explanation
variables.example: A will also names a guardian for kids and decides who gets accounts, cars and keepsakes. Without one, state law decides for you.

variables.name: key_rule
variables.description: The one line to remember, 9 words or fewer
variables.example: No will means the state writes one for you

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Next step for people with the same question, starting with a verb, 6 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from the matching pack in compliance/packs.json
variables.example: Attorney advertising. Past results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 flat graphic of a social media comment bubble with the text '{{viewer_question}}', anonymous avatar, soft blurred {{brand}} office background, clean modern UI style
Vertical 9:16 medium close-up of {{presenter_name}} speaking directly to camera in the {{brand}} office, soft key light, bookshelf or brand wall softly blurred, friendly confident expression

beats.purpose: call to action: ask the next question

cta: Comment your question for the next reply. {{offer}}.

craft.notes: Give the short answer in the first words of the talking beat, then explain. Viewers who only wanted the answer still feel served; viewers who stay get the reasoning. Keep the comment card fictionalized or used with permission, and blur any handle.

do_not: Show a real commenter's name or photo without their permission
Answer a question that depends on someone's specific facts as if one answer fits all
Use anyone's face or voice except the client's own presenter, with written consent
compliance: Law firm: label as attorney advertising where your state requires; add 'General information, not legal advice. No attorney-client relationship is formed'; never promise outcomes
Med spa: no guaranteed results; treatments by licensed providers; any before/after shown needs consent and an 'individual results vary' disclaimer
Financial advisor: general education, not individualized advice; no return promises; include firm disclosures
Real estate: follow fair housing rules and show brokerage name; no promises on price or timing
Fitness coach: no guaranteed weight, body or income results; label any result shown as not typical and state typical results
